text: ポケモンずかんは　パソコンつうしんで　オーキドはかせに　みてもらえる！

structure.jp: オーキドはかせに　みてもらえる！
structure.en: you can have Professor Oak look at it!

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: オーキドはかせに　みてもらえる
patterns.explanation: てもらう means someone does the thing for you, and that person gets に. もらえる is the 'can' form. オーキドはかせに みてもらえる = 'you can have Professor Oak look at it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that thing is what you use to do it. パソコンつうしんで = 'by PC link'.
